_source: Fascinating Horror (1.47M subs), Eastern Airlines 212, 2.4M views, 11:35. Built-in browser 2026-11-20: frames over 0-140 s while the audio probe ran, then stopped on the owner's order. SAMPLED, PHOTO-DRIVEN, STRUCTURE ONLY (archival photos with credits; not a picture reference for us). Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: a serif date title in white small caps on a dark vignetted grey card, a small crow mark bottom-right
hook.firstLine: On a set date in 1974, passengers on a named flight looked out at landing.

shots.picture: silent date title card, serif small caps, dark vignette
cold-open narration over dark frames, a dip to black
rapid montage of archival airline photos, a new picture every 0.5-1 s
archival fleet photos cross-dissolving, slow pan
credited photos of the aircraft type and the airports, one every ~5 s, Ken Burns
(not watched: stopped on the owner's order)

lines.gist: on a set date passengers sensed something wrong; the pilots did not
the airline's history and size over a fast then slow photo run
the aircraft, the route and the stopover airports

whyItWorks: Opens on a silent date card for ~6 s, then a dramatic-irony line: the passengers sensed danger, the pilots did not.
A 12 s burst of fast photo cuts (13 cuts) right after the hook, then slow 5 s holds: pace front-loaded.
Every photo carries its licence credit lower-left: sourcing is visible.
